title: Video-MemComp: Taylor-Guided Sensitivity-Aware Memory Management for Streaming Video Understanding
selection_reason: Video-MemCompはstreaming video MLLMで一次Taylor展開により局所近似誤差と層別感度を分離し、pre-RoPEでのtoken集約とattention保存バイアス、offline gradient/online entropyに基づく層別KV予算配分を行う。Qwen2.5-VL-3Bで精度62.3%→64.1%、KVメモリ90%超削減と報告。動画理解向けだがKV容量削減の直接的手法。
venue: Proceedings of the 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia
